children: America's Car-Mart entered into an amendment and limited waiver under its Credit and Guaranty Agreement to maintain temporary covenant relief and extend key deadlines. On Oct. 8, 2026, Silver Point, as agent, and the lenders extended the Scheduled Termination Date and relief on minimum liquidity and collateral coverage to Oct. 15, 2026. The short-term extension is intended to preserve flexibility while the company advances its strategic review and financing discussions.
